body:
[Erowid Warning: Tramadol has been associated with seizure activity, especially when taken at high doses, when taken for multiple days in a row, and in combination with other pharmaceuticals.]
I was up to 180 pills a week.  I'd place an order online every week for about 100 bucks for 180 pills.  I took every last one and would be nervous when I had 50 left!!  I stopped, hard for me to believe and I am so thankful; I basically cut down my dose over time.  In the end, I was taking 12 at a time obviously more than once a day.  Its been about 2 weeks since my last pill and I thought by now I'd be back to 'normal'.
